name: Ruth
lede: The eighth book of the Bible, in full: Naomi and Ruth the Moabitess, the field of Boaz, and the near kinsman, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Whither Thou Goest
books.blurb: Famine, Moab and three graves; Naomi turns home, Orpah kisses her, but Ruth clave unto her: whither thou goest, I will go. Call me Mara. Then the barley harvest, the field of Boaz, and under whose wings thou art come to take refuge.

books.name: The Near Kinsman
books.blurb: The threshing-floor at midnight and the skirt spread over the handmaid; six measures of barley; the near kinsman at the gate draws off his shoe; ye are witnesses; and Obed in Naomi's bosom, the father of Jesse, the father of David.
